protocolNotes: Addressing is control-element oriented with dynamic mapping to channels, depending on bank assignment - not fixed per channel.
Sending any parameter carrying a new page number triggers TotalMix to re-send every parameter of that page. This is the refresh primitive.
Page 2 and Page 4 single-channel settings are addressed by a single-channel offset from the bank start.
Display strings arrive on the same address with a Val postfix, e.g. /1/volume1Val.
kOSCScaleToggle means you never need cached state to flip a value: send 1.0 and read back the authoritative 0.0/1.0.
Four independent OSC remote controller slots exist in TotalMix settings.
newIn196: Mic/preamp gain now scaled device- and channel-dependent (disabled in 1.90 compatibility mode)
EQ band type scaled device-dependent (disabled in 1.90 compatibility mode)
Expander threshold scaled to -99.0..-20.0 (disabled in 1.90 compatibility mode)
Room Scale increment now 0.01, Auto Level Max Gain 0.5 (disabled in 1.90 compatibility mode)
Certain parameters (phantom power, instrument) checked per bus/channel, re-sending 0 when unavailable
Cue re-sends 0 on Input/Playback bus and on the Cue-To channel
Stop/Play/Record buttons no longer sent cyclically; Play alternates in pause mode
Record state added as a text string
